items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: because we did a lot of Frank Sinatra dates.

ctx.x: Yeah. I loved that studio work, though. It was good, you know. It's a wide range of things you're doing. Every day you didn't know what you were going to run into, you know, because we did a lot of Frank Sinatra dates. You didn't know what kind of arrangement you were going to play.
He did charts on the east, he did albums on the east coast?
